t: Våra värsta år: Psychic Avengers
d: Al is a broken man after the Bundys can no longer afford to buy a weekly TV Guide. When Jefferson arrives at their house with a fistful of cash, Al discovers that he has been running a psychic phone scam called "Madame Zelda."

t: Våra värsta år: My Dinner with Anthrax
d: It's Al and Peggy's 20th wedding anniversary, but Peggy only wants one thing from Al....S-E-X. Meanwhile, Kelly and Bud win the "My Dinner With Anthrax" contest which means a house party for the thrash metal band.

t: Våra värsta år: High I.Q.
d: An invitation to join the high intelligence Alpha club, is issued to Kelly and not Bud. When they discover the real reason behind the gathering, Kelly and Bud decide to handle things with the usual Bundy charm (and violence).

t: Våra värsta år: Teacher Pets
d: Bud's belief that his 40-year-old teacher is romantic interested in him is greeted by laughter from everyone. But another student smells the smoke and wants the fire for herself.

t: Våra värsta år: The Goodbye Girl
d: When Kelly's modeling school closes down, she gets a new job as a greeter at the TV World theme park. When this is threatened by her low performance ratings, Kelly is moved into Commercial Land where she plays "the Verminator" who hunts down roaches.

t: Våra värsta år: The  Gas Station Show
d: When Al can't pay his bill at the gas station, he is forced to don a uniform and work at the station. He spends the day being hounded by motorists, as well as Peg and the kids.

t: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 1
d: Lower Uncton, England 1653-- Seamus McBundy makes the mistake of insulting a witch who casts an evil spell upon the land, shading the town in darkness forever--as long as a male Bundy lives.

t: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 2
d: The Bundys delight in their comped trip to England, spending here and there. All the while, the town of Upper Uncton conspires to kill the Bundys outside Lower Uncton, so the curse will remain and Upper Uncton can still rake in profits as a tourist town.

t: Våra värsta år: England Show - Pt 3
d: The Bundys are cornered by both towns. Upper Uncton wants them dead so they can continue to profit as a tourist trap while Lower Uncton wants them dead so they can end the curse.

t: Våra värsta år: Magnificent Seven
d: Al is shocked about having another kid when Peggy's relatives leave their five-year-old son Seven in the Bundy home.

t: Våra värsta år: T-R-A-Something-Something Spells Tramp
d: Kelly has to walk through the wilderness after dumping her boyfriend in the forest. Al and Peg try to 'talk' their marriage alive, but without success. Bud dates a girl with the measles.

t: Våra värsta år: Every Bundy Has a Birthday
d: Peggy discovers that Seven does not know when his birthday is, and the family decides to celebrate him... on Al's birthday.

t: Våra värsta år: Al on the Rocks
d: Al has to take a job as a topless bartender to pay for Seven's doctor bill, but Peggy fears that Bud and Kelly might make Seven sick, and kicks them out of the house.

t: Våra värsta år: What I Did for Love
d: Peggy tries to make Al more interested in having sex with her by purchasing new dresses, unsuccessfully.

t: Våra värsta år: Frat Chance
d: Bud starts his own fraternity to get women.

t: Våra värsta år: The Chicago Wine Party
d: The Bundys vote against a two cent beer tax.

t: Våra värsta år: Kelly Doesn't Live Here Anymore
d: Al makes Kelly get a job, so she becomes a waitress.

t: Våra värsta år: Rock of Ages
d: Al and the family try to sneak into the first-class lounge by dressing up like rock stars.

t: Våra värsta år: Death of a Shoe Salesman
d: Al buys a cemetery plot so that he will be buried next to a western movie star and a mule. But Peggy feels excluded.

t: Våra värsta år: Old College Try
d: Bud gets a huge money grant to go to college, but Al and Peggy spend it all on items for themselves.

t: Våra värsta år: Christmas
d: Al remembers how the Bundys celebrated Christmas over the years.

t: Våra värsta år: The Wedding Show
d: Al becomes frustrated when Peggy can't decide what to wear to a family wedding. Meanwhile, Bud gets to know the bride and Kelly spends time with the bridesmaids.

t: Våra värsta år: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This
st: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This
d: Peggy and Marcy ruin Al's fishing trip by constantly fighting. Meanwhile, Jefferson and the kids spend Marcy's money.

t: Våra värsta år: Heels on Wheels
d: Kelly buys a motorcycle, which upsets the rest of the family who find it unsafe.

t: Våra värsta år: Mr. Empty Pants
d: Peggy creates a cartoon character named Mr. Empty Pants, who bears a strange resemblance to Al.

t: Våra värsta år: You Can't Miss
d: Bud appears on a game show for single men. Meanwhile, Al and Peg don't sleep for days, and Kelly fears that there is a conspiracy against her.

t: Våra värsta år: Peggy and the Pirates
d: Peggy tells Seven a fantasy story about pirates and beautiful princesses.

t: Våra värsta år: Go for the Old
d: Al competes in an athletic championship for seniors.

t: Våra värsta år: Un-Alful Entry
d: Al ends up being sued by a burglar after Al punches him while he breaks into the Bundy house.

t: Våra värsta år: Movie Show
d: The Bundys go to the movie theater for Kelly's birthday and they see her boyfriend with another woman.

t: Våra värsta år: Til Death Do Us Part
d: Al's lack of performance in the bedroom makes him the laugh of the town, so Al sets his mind on getting back in shape.

t: Våra värsta år: Tis Time to Smell the Roses
st: Tis Time to Smell the Roses
d: Al plans on retiring early, but Peggy spends too much money shopping and he must get a job at Homeplate Athletic Shoes.

t: Våra värsta år: Old Insurance Dodge
d: Al tries to scam the insurance company when the Dodge is stolen.

t: Våra värsta år: Wedding Repercussions
d: Bud's cousin shows up angry after finding out that someone slept with his wife before their wedding...not knowing that that person is Bud.

t: Våra värsta år: The Proposition
d: Al's old girlfriend wants to buy Al from Peggy for $500,000.

t: Våra värsta år: A Tisket, a Tasket, Can Peg Make a Basket?
st: A Tisket, a Tasket, Can Peg Make a Basket?
d: When Al and Peggy go to a basketball game, Peggy switches seats with Al and her seat is chosen for a $10,000 free throw contest.

t: Våra värsta år: Hood 'n the Boyz
d: Al helps his childhood girlfriend deal with a young tough guy and his gang.

t: Våra värsta år: Proud to Be Your Bud?
d: The family thinks Bud is insane when they overhear him talking to himself in his room.
